_comment: How loud each sound is and what drives it. The waveforms themselves are generated by tool/generate_sounds.dart and all normalised to the same peak, so the balance between them lives here and can be changed without regenerating anything (rule K3). knockFullImpulse is in kg-m/s and was derived, not guessed: two racers meeting head-on at speed v exchange (1+restitution)*v*mass/2, which is 0.039*v, so a full-power 3 m/s shunt lands at about 0.116 and a 0.1 m/s nudge at 0.004 - hence the floor, below which no knock is played at all rather than a click on every graze. slideFullSpeed is near the top launch speed, so the scrape is loudest just after release and dies with the car. slideVolume is 0 because the owner heard the first build and said the hiss was annoying and to take it out. The scrape was filtered noise, and filtered noise under a quiet game reads as a fault in the speaker rather than as a car moving. At 0 the loop is never started and the file is never fetched; raising it turns the scrape back on with no code change, which is why it lives here rather than in the waveform.
